<template>
    <v-container>
        <!-- 工程資料卡片 -->
        <v-card class="pa-4" max-width="800" style="margin: auto;">
            <v-card-title class="text-h6">填寫工程資料</v-card-title>
            <v-card-text>
                <v-form v-model="valid" ref="formRef">
                    <v-row dense>
                        <v-col cols="12" sm="6">
                            <v-text-field v-model="form.project_name" label="工程名稱" :rules="[rules.required]" outlined />
                        </v-col>
                        <v-col cols="12" sm="6">
                            <v-text-field v-model="form.contractor_name" label="承攬廠商名稱" :rules="[rules.required]" outlined />
                        </v-col>
                        <v-col cols="12" sm="6">
                            <v-text-field v-model="form.start_date" label="開工日" type="date" :rules="[rules.required]"
                                outlined />
                        </v-col>
                        <v-col cols="12" sm="6">
                            <v-text-field v-model="form.end_date" label="完工日" type="date" :rules="[rules.required]"
                                outlined />
                        </v-col>
                    </v-row>
                </v-form>
            </v-card-text>
        </v-card>

        <!-- 施工項目輸入與表格 -->
        <v-card class="pa-4 mt-4 w-100">
            <v-card-title class="text-h6">新增施工項目</v-card-title>
            <v-card-text>
                <v-row dense>
                    <v-col cols="12" md="3">
                        <v-text-field v-model="newItem.item_name" label="項目名稱" dense outlined />
                    </v-col>
                    <v-col cols="12" md="2">
                        <v-text-field v-model="newItem.unit" label="單位" dense outlined />
                    </v-col>
                    <v-col cols="12" md="2">
                        <v-text-field v-model="newItem.contract_qty" label="契約數量" type="number" dense outlined />
                    </v-col>
                    <v-col cols="12" md="3">
                        <v-select v-model="newItem.is_special" :items="['是', '否']" label="是否為特定項目" dense outlined />
                    </v-col>
                    <v-col cols="12" md="2">
                        <v-btn color="primary" @click="addItem" block>新增</v-btn>
                    </v-col>
                </v-row>

                <!-- 表格顯示已輸入項目 -->
                <v-data-table :headers="headers" :items="items" class="mt-4" dense item-value="item_name">
                    <template #item.actions="{ item, index }">
                        <v-icon small class="mr-2" @click="editItem(index)">mdi-pencil</v-icon>
                        <v-icon small @click="removeItem(index)">mdi-delete</v-icon>
                    </template>
                </v-data-table>
            </v-card-text>

            <!-- ✅ 唯一送出按鈕 -->
            <v-card-actions>
                <v-spacer></v-spacer>
                <v-btn color="success" @click="submitForm">送出全部資料</v-btn>
            </v-card-actions>
        </v-card>
    </v-container>
</template>

<script>
    export default {
        data() {
            return {
                formRef: null,
                valid: false,
                form: {
                    project_name: '',
                    contractor_name: '',
                    start_date: '',
                    end_date: ''
                },
                rules: {
                    required: v => !!v || '此欄位為必填'
                },
                newItem: {
                    item_name: '',
                    unit: '',
                    contract_qty: '',
                    is_special: '否'
                },
                items: [],
                editIndex: -1,
                headers: [
                    { title: '項目名稱', key: 'item_name' },
                    { title: '單位', key: 'unit' },
                    { title: '契約數量', key: 'contract_qty' },
                    { title: '是否為特定項目', key: 'is_special' },
                    { title: '操作', key: 'actions', sortable: false }
                ]
            }
        },
        methods: {
            addItem() {
                if (!this.newItem.item_name || !this.newItem.unit || !this.newItem.contract_qty) return
                if (this.editIndex >= 0) {
                    this.items[this.editIndex] = { ...this.newItem }
                    this.editIndex = -1
                } else {
                    this.items.push({ ...this.newItem })
                }
                this.resetNewItem()
            },
            editItem(index) {
                this.newItem = { ...this.items[index] }
                this.editIndex = index
            },
            removeItem(index) {
                this.items.splice(index, 1)
            },
            resetNewItem() {
                this.newItem = {
                    item_name: '',
                    unit: '',
                    contract_qty: '',
                    is_special: '否'
                }
            },
            submitForm() {
                // 手動檢查欄位是否填寫
                const isFormValid =
                    this.form.project_name.trim() !== '' &&
                    this.form.contractor_name.trim() !== '' &&
                    this.form.start_date.trim() !== '' &&
                    this.form.end_date.trim() !== ''

                if (!isFormValid) {
                    alert('請完整填寫所有工程資料')
                    return
                }

                if (this.items.length === 0) {
                    alert('請至少新增一筆施工項目')
                    return
                }

                // 資料沒問題就送出
                const msg = {
                    payload: {
                        ...this.form,
                        workItems: this.items
                    }
                }
                this.send(msg)
            }

        }
    }
</script>

<style scoped>
    .v-card {
        margin: auto;
    }

    .v-data-table {
        font-size: 14px;
    }
</style>

msg.topic = "SELECT \
   dr.id AS report_id, \
   dr.project_id, \
   p.name AS project_name, \
   p.contractor AS contractor, \
   CAST(DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR) AS start_date,\
   CAST(DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR) AS end_date,\
   CAST(DATE_FORMAT(dr.report_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR) AS report_date,\
   dr.weekday, \
   dr.weather_morning, \
   dr.weather_afternoon, \
   dr.planned_progress, \
   dr.actual_progress, \
   dr.other_notes, \
   dr.test_records, \
   dr.	notify_subcontractors, \
   dr.	important_notes, \
 \
   cpl.construction_item_id, \
   ci.name AS item_name, \
   ci.unit, \
   ci.contract_quantity, \
   ci.is_special, \
   cpl.quantity_today, \
   cpl.quantity_total, \
   cpl.remark \
 \
FROM daily_reports dr \
LEFT JOIN projects p ON dr.project_id = p.id \
LEFT JOIN construction_progress_logs cpl ON dr.id = cpl.report_id \
LEFT JOIN construction_items ci ON cpl.construction_item_id = ci.id \
 \
ORDER BY dr.report_date DESC, dr.id DESC;";
return msg;
